crash.body: Your last autosave is safe. Go back to the menu and use Continue, or copy the report so the problem can be replayed from its seed and commands.
error.title: Something went wrong

notice.parcelNotForSale: Protected land is not for sale.
map.align: Align view to ideal runway heading

hint.runway: Press and drag from one threshold to the other.
hint.runwayDrag: Release to build. Hold Alt for free angles.
hint.taxiway: Click to add points. Double click or Enter to finish, Backspace removes a point. Shift gives 15° steps, Alt is free.
hint.taxilane: Click to add points. Double click or Enter to finish.
hint.needRunway: Move the cursor near a runway.
hint.exit: Click to place the exit. The side follows the cursor.
hint.turnPad: Click near a runway end to place the turn pad. The side follows the cursor.
hint.parallel: Click to build a parallel taxiway with connectors.
hint.apron: Click to add corners, double click or Enter to finish. Shift gives 15 degree steps, Ctrl click cuts, A switches to rectangle.
hint.stands: Click to place the row. R rotates 90°, Shift+R 15°.
hint.gaBlock: Click to place a GA apron with tie downs. R rotates.
hint.tower: Click to place an ATC tower. Airlines need one before they fly here.
hint.demolish: Click an object to demolish it. You get 25 percent of its cost back.
inspector.title: {kind} {name}
inspector.obstacles: {n} points above the obstacle surfaces, the worst by {m} m. Buy the land to clear trees and buildings.
inspector.contactWarn: Contact stands need a terminal with a facade.
notice.notOwned: You do not own all the land under this. Buy the parcels first.
notice.runwayLength: Runways must be between {min} and {max} m long.
notice.approachNeedsPaved: Instrument approaches need a paved runway.
notice.runwayTooClose: Runways must be at least {min} m apart.
notice.taxiwayPoints: A taxiway needs between 2 and 60 points.
notice.segmentTooShort: Taxiway segments must be at least {min} m long.
notice.taxiwayTooLong: A taxiway can be at most {max} m long.
notice.exitDistance: A rapid exit must be between {min} and {max} m from the threshold.
notice.parallelTooClose: A parallel taxiway needs at least {min} m from the runway centerline.
notice.apronPoints: An apron needs between 3 and 16 corners.
notice.apronTooSmall: An apron must be at least {min} m2.
notice.standCount: You can place up to {max} stands at once.
notice.standSpacing: Stands for this code need at least {min} m between them.
notice.standNeedsApron: Jet stands must be built on an apron.
notice.standSurface: Jet stands need an asphalt or concrete apron.
notice.standSpan: This aircraft is too wide for that stand.
notice.standSurfaceType: This aircraft cannot use that stand's surface.
notice.standUsage: That stand does not take this kind of flight.
notice.standNoTerminal: That contact stand has no terminal next to it.
notice.standNoLink: That stand has no taxi route.
notice.standBusy: Another flight is on that stand at that time.
notice.towerLevel: A tower has between 1 and {max} levels.
notice.towerMaxLevel: This tower is already at its highest level.
notice.towerOnPavement: A tower cannot stand on a runway, taxiway, apron or stand.
notice.towerRunwayCap: A level {level} tower is needed for another runway.
menu.title: Airfield Tycoon
menu.tagline: Build an airport from an empty field.
menu.seedHint: The same seed always gives the same land.
menu.offline: Plays fully offline. Saves stay in this browser, use Export to keep a copy.
menu.storageBlocked: Browser storage is blocked. You can still export saves as files.
pause.title: Paused
slots.title: Flight offers
slots.help: Every signed airline offers its flights for the day with a fixed schedule and turnaround. Pick a stand here, or drag a flight onto a stand row in the stand timeline. The bar counts landings and takeoffs per hour against the tower's {cap} movements.
slots.noAirline: No airline is signed yet. Sign one in Airlines.
slots.noStand: No stand is built yet. Build stands first.
slots.noRunway: No runway is built yet. Build a runway first.
slots.noOffers: No flight is left to offer today.
ready.noTerminal: Lay a foundation, floor and walls.
ready.noCheckIn: Add check in desks in a public zone.
ready.noSecurity: Add a security lane on the public and secure border.
ready.noSeating: Add seating in a secure zone.
ready.noSecurityLink: Passengers cannot walk from the check in desks to a security lane. Join them with floor, open edges or doors.
ready.securityBypass: Passengers can reach the secure zone without a security lane. Close the gap with a wall.
ready.noSeatingLink: No secure seating is reachable through a security lane.
ready.noGateDesk: A terminal with gates has no gate desk
ready.noGateDeskLink: No walkable path from security to a gate desk
ready.noAtc: Build an ATC tower inside the airport.
hud.debug: Traffic overlay: amber rings wait on a reservation, red rings were in a deadlock
hud.walkGraph: Walking graph of the selected terminal
hint.runwayExtendPick: Click the runway end you want to extend, then click or drag outward past it.
hint.runwayShortenPick: Click the runway end you want to shorten, then click or drag inward along the runway.
hint.runwayResize: Click to confirm the new length. The new section joins the runway. Right click cancels.
hint.taxiExtendPick: Click a taxiway end, then click points to continue it. Double click or Enter finishes.
hint.taxiTrimPick: Click the taxiway end you want to shorten.
hint.taxiTrimTo: Click a point on the taxiway. Everything from that end up to it is removed.
hint.taxiCutPick: Click a taxiway where the section to remove starts.
hint.taxiCutTo: Click where the section ends. It is removed and the taxiway is split in two.
notice.pickRunwayEnd: Click close to a runway end.
notice.resizeNothing: Move the pointer along the runway to set the new length.
notice.runwayInUse: A taxiway or exit still uses that part of the runway. Remove it first.
notice.holdTooClose: A holding point stays at least {min} m from the runway centerline.
notice.holdTooFar: A holding point can move out to {max} m from the runway centerline.
notice.holdBeyondTaxiway: The taxiway does not reach that far from the runway.
ghost.holding: Holding point {d} m from the centerline, at least {min} m
hint.holdDrag: Drag along the taxiway to move the holding point. It never moves closer than the default.
inspector.runwayUpgradeHint: Upgrading costs money, downgrading refunds a quarter. Connectors follow the new pavement edge.
stands.title: Stand management
stands.autoTip: On: flights without a stand take the best free one. Off: flights wait for a stand you assign.
stands.help: Drag a flight onto a stand row, or click it and pick a stand.
stands.openTip: A closed stand takes no aircraft.
stands.dragHint: Drop on a stand, or on the unassigned lane.
hint.runwayUpgrade: Click a runway to change its class, approach or strength in the inspector.
land.title: Land acquisition
land.help: Click a parcel to see its price and buy it. Building tools are off in this mode.
classes.title: What do the classes mean?
classes.intro: The class letter is set by the widest aircraft the pavement is built for, measured by wingspan. A higher class means wider pavement, bigger turns and more separation, so it costs more land and money. A runway or taxiway can only take aircraft up to its class.
classes.row: wingspan {span} m. Runway {rw} m wide, taxiway {tw} m wide, corner radius {r} m.

notice.terminalOnPavement: A terminal cannot sit on a runway, taxiway or apron, or too close to one.
notice.terminalNearRunway: A terminal cannot be built that close to a runway.

sites.title: Site
hint.terminal.zone: Drag over floor to paint a zone. Check in sits in public, security on the border, seating and gates in secure, shops in commercial, belts and the control room in staff only.
notice.wrongZone: That fixture does not fit this zone. Check in needs public, shops need commercial, belts need public or staff only, the control room needs staff only.
notice.zoneHasFixture: A fixture stands there that does not fit the zone you are painting.
alert.noAtc: {name} cannot fly here until an ATC tower stands at the airport.
alert.atcLost: Your old control room no longer provides ATC. Build an ATC tower to bring the airlines back.
alert.atcOverload: The tower is at its hourly limit. {n} movements are waiting. Upgrade the tower to handle more.
hint.terminal.foundation: Drag to lay a foundation. The first one starts a new building, R rotates it 90°. Build near the stands.
hint.terminal.floor: Drag over foundation to lay flooring.
hint.terminal.wall: Drag along a grid line to build a wall. Hold nothing, it snaps to the grid.
hint.terminal.door: Click a wall to put in a door, or a bare edge to open it.
hint.terminal.fixture: Drag over floor to place the chosen fixture in every free cell.
hint.terminal.erase: Drag to clear floor, fixtures and walls. Walls beside empty floor go too.
terminal.capacity: Departures {dep} per hour, arrivals {arr} per hour
inspector.terminalHint: Use the terminal tool to add or change anything.
notice.terminalBounds: That is outside the terminal's building area (320 m square).
notice.terminalTooLarge: That area is too large for one edit.
notice.terminalNeedsFoundation: There is no foundation there. Lay a foundation first.
notice.wallStraight: Walls run along a single grid line, horizontal or vertical.
notice.surfaceCode: Code {code} needs an asphalt or concrete surface.
notice.worksRunning: Surface works are already under way here.
notice.padExists: There is already a turn pad at this end on this side. Remove it first.
notice.surfaceExcludesType: This surface would shut out the {type}, which an airline flies here.
inspector.surfaceCost: Upgrade cost {cost}, works {days} days, segment closed during works, markings regenerate.
inspector.surfaceRefund: Downgrade refunds {cost}, works {days} days, segment closed during works, markings regenerate.
inspector.worksUnderWay: Works to {surface} under way, {days} days left. The taxiway is closed.
inspector.surfaceNeedsPaved: Codes D to F need asphalt or concrete.
ghost.clearance: Wingtip clearance: keep {m} m from stands and buildings
ghost.taxiSeparation: Too close beside a taxiway: {m} m between centerlines
notice.nodesTooClose: Two nodes would be closer than {min} m. Snap to the existing node instead.
hint.apronRect: Drag a rectangle. It aligns to the runway frame and snaps to apron and taxiway edges. Ctrl drag cuts, A switches to free polygon, Alt is free.
